mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today is balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 61 degrees. The moon is in its First Quarter phase. Tonight, we expect an overnight low of 60 degrees, and rain is predicted as we move into tomorrow.

The city has announced that chip seal road maintenance begins on September 23. Areas affected include Cross Country Road and parts of the Liberty Business Park, so please drive with caution. Additionally, the Plan Commission will meet on October 5 to discuss various development projects.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey is Run and Lake Lou-ee. Looking to tomorrow, check out the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival in Paoli or head into Madison for the Dane County Farmer is Market.

In our weekly police update, on September 10, officers were dispatched to a reported burglary on Hunters Cove Way. A suspect was located and detained after breaking into a building, and the department has issued a full report on the incident.
Culver is of Verona is closed today for their scheduled remodel. They will be back to serving up your favorite treats soon, so stay tuned for updates.
